171:t_1:3.en: ～ $$プトレマイオス２改$$ Briefing Room ～

171:t_1:4.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Captain $$ブライト$$... What exactly did Colonel $$シャア$$ mean about $$プラント$$ making a move?」

171:t_1:5.en:
$$ブライト$$
「$$プラント$$ has leaned toward $$ネオ・ジオン$$ from the start, ever since the $$時獄戦役$$...」

171:t_1:6.en:
$$ブライト$$
「$$シャア$$ saw the situation as dangerous and was running his own investigation of $$プラント$$, but...」

171:t_1:7.en:
$$ブライト$$
「He judged the trend has grown stronger in recent weeks, and that at this rate even a full-scale armed intervention, which never happened in the $$時獄戦役$$, could occur.」

171:t_1:8.en:
$$オットー$$
「So that's why Colonel $$シャア$$ came to the $$ラー・カイラム$$, to consider countermeasures.」

171:t_1:9.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Was he told of $$フル・フロンタル$$'s declaration in advance, and is this a response to it?」

171:t_1:11.en:
$$ブライト$$
「When $$シャア$$ was the Leader of $$ネオ・ジオン$$, he questioned $$プラント$$'s haste and kept their cooperation in check, though.」

171:t_1:12.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Now that the Leader has changed to $$フロンタル$$, $$プラント$$ is finally going to move too...」

171:t_1:13.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「But in the $$ＵＣＷ$$ $$多元戦争$$, Chairman Gilbert 《$$デュランダル$$》, who was their leader, fell...」

171:t_1:14.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「I hear $$プラント$$ shifted to a policy of cooperation with Earth.」

171:t_1:15.en:
$$ブライト$$
「The $$クライン$$ faction's efforts count for a great deal in that.」

171:t_1:16.en:
$$オットー$$
「The faction led by the songstress $$ラクス・クライン$$, then...」

171:t_1:18.en:
$$ブライト$$
「There's no other way to put it.」

171:t_1:20.en:
$$ブライト$$
「What is it, Captain $$オットー$$?」

171:t_1:21.en:
$$オットー$$
「Is it not possible that this $$クライン$$ faction has colluded with $$ネオ・ジオン$$...?」

171:t_1:22.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「I don't think so. I can't imagine $$ラクス・クライン$$, the symbol of the $$クライン$$ faction, allowing such a thing.」

171:t_1:23.en:
$$ブライト$$
「I agree. ...But I can understand Captain $$オットー$$'s concern too.」

171:t_1:24.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「For now, all we can do is wait to hear from $$キラ$$ and the others who infiltrated ahead of us.」

171:t_1:25.en:
$$オットー$$
「Is there no way to contact $$シン・アスカ$$, who's in $$プラント$$?」

171:t_1:27.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Considering all that, we'd better be prepared for the fact that something is happening in $$プラント$$.」

171:t_1:28.en:
$$ブライト$$
「During the $$時獄戦役$$, $$シン$$ and $$キラ$$ said that $$プラント$$ was heading toward war on a tide of emotion.」

171:t_1:29.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Finding out where its roots lie will probably be the key to understanding the situation...」

171:t_1:33.en: ～ $$プラント$$ - $$アプリリウス市$$ Hidden Passage ～

171:t_1:35.en:
$$キラ$$
「Let's rest for a bit, $n. We've been walking the whole time since we infiltrated, so you must be tired.」

171:t_1:36.en:
$n
「No... I'm all right. I'm also worried about $$ヒイロ$$ and the others, who are infiltrating by a different route.」

171:t_1:37.en:
$$キラ$$
「Don't push yourself. The meeting point with $$ラクス$$ is just a little further, and this place is safe.」

171:t_1:38.en:
$n
「...Then, may I talk with you for a little while?」

171:t_1:39.en:
$$キラ$$
「So that's why you asked to come with me.」

171:t_1:40.en:
$n
「Yes... For some reason, it's hard to talk on the ship...」

171:t_1:42.en:
$n
「...I met Ensign $$リディ$$ right after I started piloting the $$ジェニオン$$, but...」

171:t_1:43.en:
$n
「Since around the end of the $$時獄戦役$$, I haven't been able to understand him...」

171:t_1:45.en:
$n
「I'm sure things were hard for him because of his family and all, but I want to know why Ensign $$リディ$$ changed.」

171:t_1:46.en:
$n
「I thought you, $$キラ$$, who were with him in $$オーブ$$, might understand something...」

171:t_1:47.en:
$$キラ$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$ is... the same as you... no, the same as us.」

171:t_1:49.en:
$$キラ$$
「To the very end, the Ensign fought to protect what was precious to him, what he believed in.」

171:t_1:50.en:
$$キラ$$
「I think he only seemed to have changed because that precious thing came to take up a much bigger share of his heart than anything else.」

171:t_1:51.en:
$n
「Are you the same, $$キラ$$? Do you fight for what's precious to you, for what you believe in?」

171:t_1:53.en:
$n
「Is that... about $$ラクス$$, who we're about to meet?」

171:t_1:55.en:
$n
「Oh... um... sorry... I'm not being nosy... it's just that $$シン$$ said something like that before...」

171:t_1:57.en:
$$キラ$$
「But maybe it's a little different from what you imagine.」

171:t_1:58.en:
$$キラ$$
「What's precious to me isn't only $$ラクス$$, but everything she believes in, hopes for, and aims for.」

171:t_1:60.en:
$$キラ$$
「You think so? I think it's the same as what you feel toward Miss $$スズネ$$...」

171:t_1:62.en:
$$キラ$$
「...Sorry. The person who's precious to you is someone else, isn't she?」

171:t_1:64.en:
$n
「I don't really understand how I feel about $$マキ#pilot$$ myself... And with the world in this state, our lives don't line up anymore...」

171:t_1:65.en:
$n
「Right now... as long as she's alive and safe... that's enough...」

171:t_1:66.en:
$$キラ$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$ was the same as you. That's why he fought so desperately...」

171:t_1:67.en:
$$キラ$$
「Let's do our best, $n. To protect what's precious to us.」

171:t_1:75.en:
$$キラ$$
「I was surprised. Choosing the Council's conference room as our meeting place...」

171:t_1:76.en:
$$ラクス$$
「There was something I absolutely had to tell you, and it had to be here.」

171:t_1:79.en:
$$キラ$$
「Someone came with me, but they're standing guard outside the conference room.」

171:t_1:80.en:
$$ラクス$$
「Is that person a 《$$コーディネイター$$》?」

171:t_1:85.en:
$$キラ$$
「What's wrong, $$ラクス$$? You're not like your usual self...」

171:t_1:86.en:
$$ラクス$$
「I'm sorry, $$キラ$$... I had meant to contact you much sooner, but I couldn't sort out my own feelings...」

171:t_1:87.en:
$$キラ$$
「It's okay, $$ラクス$$. If you do it in a way you're comfortable with, I'll wait.」
